csv_scope_of_work: The Rhode Island Department of Environmental Management (RIDEM) is requesting proposals for a Design Build Project that includes design, permitting, construction and site readiness services for the Alton Jones Campus. The buildings included under this scope are as follows. Photos of each building are included in Attachment B and property cards for all buildings apart from the sheds at the Main Office and barns at Woodvale Farm are included as Attachment C: Main Office Campus: - Main Office - Five (5) sheds - Garage EEC Campus: - The Main EEC Building - Six (6) cabins - The Mouse House Woodvale Farm Campus: - Farm Classroom - Blacksmith House - Farmhouse - Machinery Barn - Cow Barn

title: Design-Build for Alton Jones Campus Construction and Site Readiness
short_description: Design-build services for renovation or readiness works across multiple campus buildings in Rhode Island.
project_location: Alton Jones Campus, West Greenwich, Rhode Island, USA
project_scope: Design-build project including design, permitting, construction, and site readiness services for multiple existing campus buildings. Scope covers Main Office Campus (main office, five sheds, garage), EEC Campus (main EEC building, six cabins, Mouse House), and Woodvale Farm Campus (farm classroom, blacksmith house, farmhouse, machinery barn, cow barn). No gross floor areas, structural spans, or detailed technical parameters are stated.
services: Design-build services including design, permitting, construction, and site readiness for multiple campus buildings and ancillary structures.
relevance_explanation:
- Multi-building campus project may offer broad structural involvement.
- Includes design-build delivery, which can create early planning entry opportunities.
- However, the notice is very general and does not describe any architecturally demanding, long-span, bridge, roof, or special structural elements.
- Building types are mostly small campus and farm structures, which appear less aligned with sbp's core focus on complex structures, bridges, and long-span roofs.
- No explicit sustainability, innovation, or advanced structural requirements are mentioned.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. The scope includes numerous existing buildings across three campus areas and covers design, permitting, construction, and site readiness over a 24-month base period with optional renewal, but there is insufficient technical and size information for a reliable cost estimate.
fee_explanation: No planning fee or design fee is stated in the source. Because building sizes, level of intervention, and procurement breakdown are not provided, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived.
references_qualifications: All disciplines requested. No specific reference projects, minimum qualifications, or certification requirements are stated in the provided source.
